title: Have you ever used AI to create something for you?
author: Humble_Bike_7314
selftext:
Hey guys!

I'm a husband and father of two who had a weird idea while flying its drone.

**WHAT IF MY DRONE HAD WEAPONS?**

That sounded insanely fun in my head. I thought of it as flying through obstacles, being chased by other drones, locking on targets while evading missiles... That sounded super cool for a sec lol 

So, I searched for a couple of video games but wasn't really finding what I was looking for. Since everyone has been creating stuff with AI I thought MAYBE I could try to make a videogame like that. So got to build something weirdly fun.

**Have you guys had any crazy idea and used AI to build it just for you?** I'd like to know!

replies.author: Humble_Bike_7314
replies.body: I love how we can get creative nowadays without the need of becoming an expert at something! I'm glad to see others have fun too!!

replies.author: Humble_Bike_7314
replies.body: Hey buddy! I used \`Claude Code\` for coding it in C# using Unity. I know it sounds scary but with AI its not! It takes a lot of time tho 😛

comments.author: Romellija
comments.body: How did you manage to do the map?

replies.author: Humble_Bike_7314
replies.body:
Well, what you see in the video is actually a demo scene from an asset I bought at the Unity Asset Store. I don't remember exactly which one is it cause I got it a long time ago. 

There are many free assets in the store to get started tho 😃

replies.author: Romellija
replies.body: Aah nice. I must have a look again. Game looks cool tho..keep it up!

comments.author: somnut
comments.body: Are the assets also ai generated? Like how much do you guide the AI vs you just let it run

replies.author: oVerde
replies.body: No, he replied at another question that assets are form Unity store

replies.author: Humble_Bike_7314
replies.body:
Just like u/oVerde said, the assets (all of them) were acquired from Unity Asset Store. Some of them free, some others paid 👀

AI is actually pretty decent. I used Claude Code for this. It can find errors and fix them, while developing features. It is not autonomous enough for you to say "Lets create a weaponized drones game", you sort of need to guide it through the whole process 😅

comments.body: I made something with quite a similar feeling. First person, racing around simple procedurally generated blocky "cities", and tunnels as well. I didn't bother with weapons, but it could be cool.

Thanks!!

comments.author: mikmoniks
comments.body: Yes, I have a game in the Play Store,  a visual mystery game. All the art assets are AI-generated; all the dialogues are AI-generated. It is not like AI gives us things on a silver plate; we need to do hundreds of revisions to get things to work. Still, AI is the best assistant we can have.

replies.author: Humble_Bike_7314
replies.body: Ooh you even uploaded it to a store? That's genuinely awesome!! At first people might think that AI will do it for you, but it still needs you to guide it through the whole process 😃. Still, it makes it infinitely easier than those times without AI haha
